g.text: Continuous batching turns a small model into cheap capacity

g.text: Measured with the selected Qwen3.5-2B SFT adapter, vLLM 0.29.0, BF16, and ~1,065 tokens/recommendation on a RunPod RTX 4090 ($0.74/h). Squares are sustained 1,200-request confirmations; all requests produced valid top-3 JSON.
